source_artifacts.used_for: original intake witness for the distinction-density bridge and endpoint non-realizability reading

purpose: Witness the governed rate-type eligibility predicate as the first admissibility screen for metric-bridge evaluation, keeping admission distinct from promotion.

non_claims: Does not assert external physical truth.
Does not assert a completed metric.

report_frame.scope: This candidate is scoped to the internal relation between distinction density, propagation position, and endpoint realizability.
directly_observed_or_defined: Probability is already treated as a projection rather than primitive causation in the textbook.
Distinction density is already tracked as a governed bridge quantity in the induction packet.
The bridge-admissibility protocol requires a declared object, declared observable, explicit mapping, and explicit falsification conditions.
The intake packet defines RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi) and a distinction-density bridge as provisional.
inferred_inside_framework: Distinction density can be treated as the bridge quantity from which probability, statistics, entropy, and propagation limits appear as domain projections.
Propagation position can be treated as a derived quantity governed by the resolution rate of A|E tension.
The 0 DOF decoupled endpoint is modeled as a non-realizable limit under admissible continuation.
RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi) depends on declared reference, coupled A|E relation, and endpoint compatibility.
external_resemblance: The bridge resembles rate, density, and boundary reasoning in information-theoretic and constrained-dynamical settings.
The comparison is analogical only and does not claim identity with external theory.
what_it_does_not_prove: Does not prove the bridge is externally true.
Does not prove the bridge is unique.
Does not prove endpoint non-realizability outside the framework.
Does not prove probability, statistics, or entropy are primitives.
failure_modes_uncertainty: The bridge collapses to narrative if no new predicate or invariant is introduced.
The endpoint claim overreaches if phi and the admissibility floor are not declared before evaluation.
The candidate remains provisional until independent derivation and adversarial testing.
Cross-domain discrimination still needs at least three independent domains with one pass, one failure, and one ambiguous case.

bridge_context.endpoint_reading: A true 0 DOF decoupled endpoint is treated as non-realizable in the candidate reading; observable systems remain in the coupled interior and approach endpoint conditions asymptotically.

candidate_bridge.endpoint_reading: A true 0 DOF decoupled endpoint is treated as non-realizable in the candidate reading; observable systems remain in the coupled interior and approach endpoint conditions asymptotically.

secondary_bridge_candidate.reading: Resolution rate of A|E tension is treated as a common mechanism underlying propagation position across domains, but it remains a candidate and is not promotion-eligible.

candidate_predicate.name: RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi)
candidate_predicate.formal_shape: RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi) := DOF(x) > 0 ∧ Coupled_AE(x) ∧ Declared(phi) ∧ OrderedIntermediate(x, phi) ∧ EndpointCompatible(x, phi) ∧ GenExclusionBeforeClosure(x, phi)

candidate_principle.name: Non-Realizability of Decoupled Endpoints
candidate_principle.statement: A true 0 DOF endpoint cannot be realized by any admissibly coupled continuation. Observable systems exist only within the coupled interior and approach endpoint conditions asymptotically.
candidate_consequences: RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE necessarily fails at true 0 DOF.

governance_rules: Candidate readings are internal and provisional.
The bridge may not be treated as proof of external physical truth.
phi must be declared before any rate typing evaluation.
Decoupled endpoint claims remain non-promotional until independently derived and adversarially tested.

witnesses.statement: Declaring phi before evaluation makes the screen relative rather than absolute.

witnesses.statement: DOF(x) > 0 and Coupled_AE(x) remain gating conditions rather than bridge conclusions.

witnesses.name: Endpoint witness
witnesses.statement: Ordered intermediate relation and endpoint compatibility keep the candidate inside the coupled interior.

forbidden_inferences: RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE does not prove bridge truth.
